payout_value_note: $50 to the referring member and $50 to the new member. No limit on the number of referrals.
payout_quote: Invite your friends or family to join and we'll give both of you $50!* ... $50 for you, $50 for them. The more you refer, the more you can earn!
steps: Member (18+, active, in good standing) provides their info plus the friend's name and email on the referral page.
CRFCU sends the friend one invitation email about membership.
The friend (within CRFCU's Field of Membership) becomes a member and opens at least one of: a checking account with direct deposit, a CRFCU loan, a money market account, or a share certificate.
Referral deposited to the referring member's primary savings account once criteria are met; the referring member must have an active primary savings account at payout.
catches: No limit on referrals — but the friend must open a qualifying product: checking WITH direct deposit, a loan, a money market, or a share certificate (a plain savings account does not qualify).
Only one referral payout per individual referred.
Friend must be within CRFCU's Field of Membership.
Referral deposited to the referring member's primary savings account, which must be active at payout.
Program subject to change at any time; 'speak with a staff member for further details' — page terms are somewhat thin.
biggest_catch: The friend can't just open a plain savings account — they need checking with direct deposit, a loan, a money market, or a share certificate to trigger the $50.
eligibility: Community Resource FCU membership (Latham, NY area field of membership); 18+.
timing: Referral form ~5 min active; payout after criteria met.
